title: Grid Game 2
statementMd:
You are playing "Grid Game 2" with your friend. There is a grid with $10^9$ rows (numbered from $1$ to $10^9$) and $10^9$ columns (numbered from $1$ to $10^9$). The cell at row $r$ and column $c$ is denoted as $(r, c)$.

Each cell can have a colour of either black or white. Initially, there are exactly $N$ black cells (numbered from $1$ to $N$). Black cell $i$ is located at $(R_i, C_i)$. The rest of the cells are white.

You and your friend will alternately take turn playing on this grid, and you are playing in the first turn. In one turn, a player will choose a black cell $(r, c)$, then toggle cells $(r - x, c - y)$ for all $0 \leq x, y \lt \min(r, c)$. If a cell is toggled, then the cell becomes black if it was a white cell, and the cell becomes white if it was a black cell.

For example, the following illustration shows how the grid changes after a player chooses a black cell $(5, 4)$ in their turn.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/14a831191fd8c8fb14500174bac6e9cefe7bc9e8.png)

A player who is unable to play on their turn, i.e. no remaining black cells, loses the game, and the opposing player wins the game. If you and your friend are playing optimally, determine who will win the game.

## Input

The first line consists of an integer $N$ ($1 \le N \le 200\,000$).

Each of the next $N$ lines consists of two integers $R_i$ $C_i$ ($1 \leq R_i, C_i \leq 10^9)$. For $1 \leq i \lt j \leq N$, $(R_i, C_i) \neq (R_j, C_j)$.

## Output

Output `FIRST` if you will win the game, or `SECOND` otherwise.

## Note

*Explanation for the sample input/output #1*

You can start your move by choosing $(2, 4)$, whose effect was demonstrated in the following illustration.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0242f76ef365581339f2fc263320bba07108c67d.png)

The remaining black cells are $(1, 3)$ and $(1, 4)$, each of which will only toggle itself when chosen. Whichever your friend chooses on the next move, the you can choose the remaining black cell.

*Explanation for the sample input/output #2*

You have only one cell to choose, and will toggle cells $(1, 1)$, $(1, 2)$, $(2, 1)$, and $(2, 2)$. Your friend and you will alternately choose the remaining black cells with your friend choosing the last black cell.
statementZhMd:
你正在和朋友一起玩“网格游戏 2”。有一个包含 $10^9$ 行和 $10^9$ 列的网格，行编号为 $1$ 至 $10^9$，列编号为 $1$ 至 $10^9$。第 $r$ 行第 $c$ 列的单元格记为 $(r, c)$。

每个单元格的颜色可以是黑色或白色。初始时，恰好有 $N$ 个黑色单元格（编号为 $1$ 至 $N$）。第 $i$ 个黑色单元格位于 $(R_i, C_i)$。其余单元格均为白色。

你和朋友将在这个网格上轮流进行操作，并且由你先手。在一次操作中，玩家选择一个黑色单元格 $(r, c)$，然后对所有满足 $0 \leq x, y \lt \min(r, c)$ 的单元格 $(r - x, c - y)$ 进行翻转。如果一个单元格被翻转，则它会由白色变为黑色，或由黑色变为白色。

例如，下面的插图展示了玩家在一次操作中选择单元格 $(5, 4)$ 后网格的变化。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/14a831191fd8c8fb14500174bac6e9cefe7bc9e8.png)

如果玩家在自己的回合无法进行操作，即不存在剩余的黑色单元格，则该玩家输掉游戏，其对手获胜。假设你和朋友都采取最优策略，判断最终谁会获胜。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $N$（$1 \leq N \leq 200\,000$）。

接下来的 $N$ 行中，每行包含两个整数 $R_i$ 和 $C_i$（$1 \leq R_i, C_i \leq 10^9$）。对于 $1 \leq i \lt j \leq N$，$(R_i, C_i) \neq (R_j, C_j)$。

## 输出格式

如果你获胜，输出 `FIRST`；否则输出 `SECOND`。

## 说明

*样例输入/输出 #1 的解释*

你可以选择 $(2, 4)$ 开始操作，其效果如下图所示。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0242f76ef365581339f2fc263320bba07108c67d.png)

剩余的黑色单元格为 $(1, 3)$ 和 $(1, 4)$，选择其中任意一个时，都只会翻转它自身。无论你的朋友在下一回合选择哪个单元格，你都可以选择剩下的那个黑色单元格。

*样例输入/输出 #2 的解释*

你只有一个单元格可以选择，并且会翻转单元格 $(1, 1)$、$(1, 2)$、$(2, 1)$ 和 $(2, 2)$。之后你和朋友将轮流选择剩余的黑色单元格，最终由你的朋友选择最后一个黑色单元格。
